ui_bugs.issue: When RC keys are blank, isLoading stays true forever because customerInfoQuery is gated by identityBound which never flips to true (Purchases.logIn fails). Result: user sees an infinite ActivityIndicator spinner + 'Setting up secure payments…' identityError banner instead of the plans-unavailable fallback described in the review request. The plans-unavailable + plans-restore testIDs at paywall.tsx:195-217 are therefore unreachable on web preview with blank keys. Fix idea: when identityError is non-null, treat isLoading as false and fall through to the packages.length===0 branch so plans-unavailable + Restore Purchases button render. Reference: /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx:184-217 and /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:84-148.

rca_of_issue: Paywall spinner-vs-plans-unavailable divergence RCA: In /app/frontend/src/lib/revenuecat.tsx:84-91, customerInfoQuery.enabled = rcEnabled && identityBound. On web preview with blank RC keys, initializeRevenueCat → Purchases.configure throws 'RevenueCat public API keys not found', so when useRevenueCat's useEffect calls Purchases.logIn(id), it throws, setIdentityBound stays false, and identityError gets set. customerInfoQuery.isLoading in @tanstack/react-query v5 for a disabled query is actually true until a fetch occurs — but even if false, offeringsQuery is enabled and also throws, so offeringsQuery.isLoading flips briefly. Combined, hook returns isLoading=true early, then settles to isLoading=false with empty packages. The transient-to-settled transition on web is observed as a near-permanent spinner because the queries continuously retry on errors with the react-query default retry policy (3 retries, exponential backoff). Mitigation: either (a) set retry:false on both queries, or (b) treat identityError as 'loading complete, no plans' in paywall.tsx so the plans-unavailable branch renders. Neither is strictly required for the iOS App Store build (iOS uses real RC keys) but matches the review-request expectation.
